title.v: Bút toán kết chuyển tự động

action.text:
select stt, stt_rec into #$dmkc1 from dmkc1 where nam = @y and exists(select 1 from @s where patindex('%,' + rtrim(stt_rec) + ',%', text) > 0) update a set user_id0 = @@userID, user_id2 = @@userID from dmkc1 a join #$dmkc1 b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where a.nam = @y if not exists(select 1 from dmstt where day(ngay_dn2) = 1 and month(ngay_dn2) = 1) or @p2 <> 12 begin delete a from #$dmkc1 a join dmkc b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec where b.loai_kc = 5 end exec rs_CreateClosingTrans @p1, @p2, @y, @@userID, @u, @@admin, @@language
declare @q nvarchar(max), @p int select stt_rec, nam, 0 as ky, stt_rec01 + null as stt_rec_r00 into #kc1 from dmkc1 a where nam = @y and exists(select 1 from #$dmkc1 where stt_rec = a.stt_rec) set @p = @p1 while @p <= @p2 begin set @q = 'update #kc1 set ky = @p, stt_rec_r00 = b.stt_rec' + replace(str(@p, 2), ' ', '0') + ' from #kc1 a join dmkc1 b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.nam = b.nam;' exec sp_executesql @q, N'@p int', @p
set @p = @p + 1 end
select top 0 a.* into #gl from r00$000000 a right join (select null b) b on 1 = 0 set @q = '' select @q = @q + 'insert into #gl select * from r00$' + dyn + ' a where exists(select 1 from #kc1 where stt_rec_r00 = a.stt_rec);' from (select distinct replace(str(nam, 4) + str(ky, 2), ' ', '0') as dyn from #kc1) a exec (@q)
select '' as array$, a.stt_rec, sum(b.ps_no) as ps_no from #kc1 a join #gl b on a.stt_rec_r00 = b.stt_rec where b.ma_dvcs = @u group by a.stt_rec order by a.stt_rec return /* drop table #$dmkc1 select 1 as value return */

select stt, stt_rec into #$dmkc1 from dmkc1 where nam = @y and exists(select 1 from @s where patindex('%,' + rtrim(stt_rec) + ',%', text) > 0) exec rs_DeleteClosingTrans @p1, @p2, @y, @@userID, @@admin, @u, 'Delete' drop table #$dmkc1 select 2 as value return
